verdict.rationale: CrewAI AMP documents deploying crews to managed infrastructure "with a few clicks" and accessing deployed crews via REST API. The API reference lists POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id} and POST /resume endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the deployed-endpoint workflow, and detail on deployment mechanics such as auth and scaling (no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths).
